caption: The drawing depicts three wooden figures arranged in a row and standing on a wooden base. The figures appear to represent two adults on either side and a smaller figure, resembling a child, in the center. Each figure is colored with shades of red, blue, green, and some brown. The adult male figure on the left has a beard, wears a tall hat in yellow and brown colors, a red robe decorated with small patterns, a green diagonal sash with blue dots, and an ornament resembling a cross on his chest. The figure in the middle, smaller in stature, is dressed in a red outfit with similar patterning and also has a cross design on the chest. The adult female figure on the right has long hair covered partially by a blue headscarf, wears a long red dress with blue and white patterned details, and a necklace with a cross. All three figures are holding hands, with the child's arms extended outwards to connect with the adults. The facial features of the figures are distinctly outlined in black, and their feet are not visible as they are positioned on the wooden platform. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the figures and base.
title: Bulto (The Holy Family)
